key_reasoning.reason: 4 controllers + 3 services + 5 new shared types (ApiResponse<T>, ErrorResponse, GlobalExceptionHandler, ResourceNotFoundException, RegistrationMismatchException) across backend and frontend subsystems. ApiResponse<T> changes the public REST contract consumed by the frontend; frontend/src/api.js updated in tandem — a cross-system contract boundary is crossed. Red flag applied: large-subsystem refactoring (all controllers and services standardized in one change) bumps XL to XXL.

18 files changed per diffstat. Actual-mode mapping: 16+ files = XXL. 7 new files (ApiResponse, ErrorResponse, GlobalExceptionHandler, RegistrationMismatchException, ResourceNotFoundException, GlobalExceptionHandlerTest, ConferenceControllerTest) and 11 modified files across 8 directories.

4 distinct layers touched: UI (frontend/src/api.js updated to consume {data:...} envelope and drop the data.data||data workaround), API (4 controllers wrapped with ApiResponse<T> and error responses delegated to GlobalExceptionHandler), Service (3 services updated to throw ResourceNotFoundException and RegistrationMismatchException instead of NoSuchElementException), Infrastructure/cross-cutting (GlobalExceptionHandler + ApiResponse + ErrorResponse + 2 exception types introduced as shared foundation). No persistence or external layers touched.
